content: सीमन्तः [सीम्नोऽन्तः शकं˚] .²1 A boundary-line, landmark. .²2 The parting line of the hair; the hair parted on each side of the head so as to leave a line; सीमन्तः केशवेशे, सीमान्तोऽन्यः <ls>Sk.</ls> (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>भांग</ns>); सीमन्ते च त्वदुपगमजं यत्र नीपं वधूनाम् <ls>Me. 67</ls>; <ls>Śi. 8. 69</ls>; <ls>Mv. 5. 44</ls>. .²3 A landmark. .²4 See सीमन्तोन्नयनम् below; <ls>Y. 1. 11</ls>.
